text: It's my partner's lad, he's 9. Neither of us has slept. He's at 38.1 and won't settle, keeps getting up. While I was trying to get him back to bed I noticed some little dark red spots on his tummy, did the glass thing and they're still there, they don't go. And when I asked him to look down at them he wouldn't put his chin down, says he can't really bend his neck forward. Not sure what to do, I'm shattered and his mum's away
